name: itero-skills
description: Skills and workflows for building with AI as a non-developer, by Max Moore (Itero Digital)

plugins.name: max-coding-workflow
plugins.description: A repo-first process for building software with an AI coding agent: kickoff interview, backlog, architecture with an ADR log, per-requirement plans, independent code review, and session checkpointing.
